Radiology Division
Ziekenhuis Gelderse Vallei, Ede
08 February 2025 | Multiparametric MRI of the Prostate
Indication: Assessment of elevated prostate-specific antigen (11.0 ng/mL) alongside a previously unremarkable biopsy.
Findings: The gland occupies 41.0 mL. T2 sequences highlight a 12 mm focal zone of intermediate signal within the left mid-gland peripheral region. Diffusion mapping reveals moderate restriction paralleled by intermediate ADC values. Post-contrast dynamics show absent early or focal enhancement. Seminal vesicles appear intact. No extraprostatic spread or suspicious nodal enlargement is detected.
Impression:
PI-RADS 3 lesion located in the left mid-gland peripheral zone.
Prostate volume 41.0 mL, PSA density 0.27 ng/mL/mL.
csPCa predicted probability 0.581638.

previous_notes.author: Dr. N. Kuiper (GP)
previous_notes.text: In July 2023, a prostate-specific antigen level of 6.3 ng/mL was recorded, triggering a repeat assay and clinical reassessment. Due to the upward trend and a history of negative sampling, urological referral was initiated. Standard laboratory panels and a digital rectal examination were completed at the clinic before the file was sent for specialist review.
